summary: Human resources professional with 3.5 years of experience in recruitment, performance management, training & development, and HRIS administration. Skilled in employee onboarding, ISO documentation, and HR policy implementation.

experience.title: HR Assistant
responsibilities: Sourced and shortlisted candidates from job portals and internal databases.
Coordinated interviews and conducted preliminary screenings.
Prepared and issued offer letters, appointment letters, and salary breakdowns.
Managed onboarding and induction programs for new hires.
Assisted in designing performance appraisal forms and competency frameworks.
Conducted PMS awareness workshops and guided employees on appraisal forms.
Maintained MIS, HRIS, and employee master data; generated reports on attrition and transfers.
Identified training needs, planned training programs, and managed training budgets.
Handled leave & attendance records, payroll entries, and salary advance details.
Tested and uploaded live data into Greytip HRIS.
Maintained ISO HR dashboard and handled employee grievances.

experience.title: Management Trainee, QA
responsibilities: Participated in quality processes for projects under ISO 9001:2000.
Monitored fortnightly reports and quality objectives.
Conducted QMS induction for new hires and ensured statutory compliance.
Received training on Software Development Life Cycle.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
responsibilities: Screened and shortlisted candidates via job portals.
Coordinated walk‑in recruitment and telephonic interviews.
Prepared offer and appointment letters; managed joining formalities.
Conducted induction to HR policies and facilitated a friendly onboarding environment.
Maintained hard and soft copies of employee records.
Addressed staff concerns and managed exit formalities and interviews.
Administered performance appraisals.

projects.name: Performance Management System
projects.description: Designed and implemented performance appraisal forms, competency frameworks, and PMS awareness workshops across the organization.
